name: ttest_extras
expr: [h_p, p_p, ci_p] = ttest(x, y); [h95, p95, ci95] = ttest(x, 4, 'Alpha', 0.05); [h99, p99, ci99] = ttest(x, 4, 'Alpha', 0.01); [h2_eq, p2_eq, ci2_eq] = ttest2(x, y); [h2_un, p2_un, ci2_un] = ttest2(x, y, 'Vartype', 'unequal');
comment: Sig: ttest(x, y[, NV]) paired form; ttest2 default Vartype=equal (pooled). NV pairs: Alpha, Tail, Vartype, Dim (Dim throws). 4th output struct (tstat/df/sd) NOT yet implemented — fingerprints stay on first 3 outputs.
